description: Bayesian marketing analytics in PyMC: media mix models, customer lifetime value, customer choice and Bass diffusion models.
rules: Import the media mix model as `from pymc_marketing.mmm import MMM`. `pymc_marketing.mmm.multidimensional` is a deprecated alias, and the pre-0.20 single-dimension MMM and `DelayedSaturatedMMM` APIs are gone.
Pass array-valued prior parameters as `xr.DataArray` with explicit `dims` so they map to the intended model dimension.
